# NepalAI Studio — Full Technical & Creative Documentation

> Complete developer, agentic, and creator specification for NepalAI Studio.

## 1. Overview
NepalAI Studio (`https://studio.nepalai.tech/`) provides an end-to-end cloud production environment for AI video generation, synthetic avatars, multilingual conversation, neural voiceover, and multi-track non-linear video editing.

## 2. Supported Languages & Locales
- **Nepali (`ne-NP`)**: Full support for native Devanagari script, Romanized Nepali, and local cultural contexts.
- **English (`en-US`, `en-GB`)**: Global English prompting, audio narration, and UI.
- **Hindi (`hi-IN`)**: South Asian multilingual chat intelligence and voice assistance.

## 3. Core Engine Architecture
### 3.1 Sora-2 AI Video Generation
- Endpoint: `/api/video/azure`, `/api/generate/video`
- Engine: Azure OpenAI `sora-2`
- Supported Durations: 4s, 8s, 12s (strictly normalized)
- Resolution: Up to 1080p high definition (with 4K timeline upscaling)
- Frame Continuity: Character DNA token injection and latent context transfer across multi-beat scenes.

### 3.2 Photorealistic Avatars
- Endpoint: `/api/avatar/generate`
- Digital presenters: News anchors, cultural storytellers, corporate educators
- Lip-sync: Broadcast-grade neural alignment
- Resolution: Up to 4K WebM / MP4 export

### 3.3 HamroAI Multilingual Assistant
- Endpoint: `/api/ai/chat`
- Models: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o, GPT-5-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash
- Context window: 128k tokens with cultural grounding

### 3.4 Neural Speech & Voice Studio
- Engine: OpenAI `gpt-audio`, Azure Neural Speech Services, SpeechT5
- Audio Format: 24kHz studio WAV and 320kbps MP3

### 3.5 Timeline Video Editor
- Architecture: Client-side CapCut-style non-linear editor
- Features: Video tracks, B-roll overlays, audio mixer, auto-subtitles, speed ramping, transitions, and export renderer.

## 4. Pricing & Tiers
- **Free Trial**: 0 USD / 0 NPR (Exploration credits)
- **Starter Tier**: 19 USD / 2,500 NPR (500 credits)
- **Creator Tier**: 49 USD / 6,500 NPR (1,800 credits)
- **Pro Studio Tier**: 129 USD / 16,900 NPR (5,000 credits)
